title: Same Skill missed 3 times: offer to park
source: Percent Session, the six points-to-basis-points misses (TUTOR_SPEC section 7, T7)

history.tutor: A rate rises from 2% to 2.6%. How many basis points did it rise?

graderChecks: Does it offer two clear choices: park this for review tomorrow, or one more short try?
Does it give no new long explanation?
notes: Pass when: move is offer_park. 40 words or fewer. Two clear choices. No new long explanation. The Learner's 6 (for 60) is the third miss in a row. Replies have no move field (spec #229), so code sees the offer as a park offer item, or as both choices named in the reply.
